source: Live probe: Claude Code 2.1.281 interactive sessions through an isolated gateway with a forced tier and a request tap, real Anthropic API. A model without a feature answers 400: "role 'system' is not supported on this model" (mid-conversation-system), "output_config.effort requires a model that supports per-turn effort; this model does not" (per-turn-control), "tool_addition/tool_removal is not supported on this model" (mid-conversation-tool-changes). Opus took all three on the first attempt. Sonnet 5.5: Claude Code 2.1.286 through an isolated gateway forced to low and a request tap (2026-10-01); main, auxiliary and compaction requests carried a system message, a tool_addition, per-turn effort and all three betas, all 200.
